officialGitDiff.twoDot: git diff A..B is synonymous with git diff A B: changes between two arbitrary commits (endpoint trees).
officialGitDiff.threeDot: git diff A...B views changes on the branch containing and up to B starting at a common ancestor. Equivalent to git diff $(git merge-base A B) B.
officialGitDiff.notGitrevisionsRanges: git-diff range notations do not mean the commit ranges defined in gitrevisions (log A..B = reachable from B not A; log A...B = symmetric difference).
